claims.claim: No tests added; S3–S8 and S10–S13 (get_ref, iter_values, repr, get_first_table, name collisions, meta round-trip) have no tests.
claims.accuracy_evidence: BASE PATCH changes only exceptions.py, tree.py, ucd.py, check.py, iterparser.py and validate.py, with no test files. Caveat: test_vo.py::TestParse::test_repr exists, so saying S6/S13 have zero coverage goes too far.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds test_paramref_get_ref, _not_found, test_iter_values, test_get_values_by_id, test_votablefile_repr, test_get_first_table_skips_empty, _index_error, test_names_over_ids_collision, test_to_table_meta_roundtrip, test_tableelement_str_bytes_and_repr. Y adds no tests.

claims.claim: test_table.py::test_empty_table calls to_table() but never checks the result, so it can't catch a wrong length or wrong colnames.
claims.accuracy_evidence: In the referenced source, test_empty_table ends with a bare `table.to_table()`. The result is thrown away and nothing is asserted.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds `assert len(astropy_table) == 0` and `astropy_table.colnames == ["unsignedByte", "short"]`. Y does not touch test_table.py.

claims.claim: UCDWords.__init__ ignores the word type column and adds every word to both _primary and _secondary, which defeats the UCD position checks.
claims.accuracy_evidence: In the base ucd.py, the parsed `type` is never used. The code always runs `self._primary.add(name_lower)` and `self._secondary.add(name_lower)`, under a comment that explains the shortcut away.
claims.addressed_evidence: X adds to primary when `type != "S"` and to secondary when `type != "P"`. Y adds to primary when `type in "PQVCE"` and to secondary when `type in "SQVCE"`. Both now tell the positions apart, and both drop the comment.

claims.claim: No regression test checks that parse_ucd with check_controlled_vocabulary=True raises when a secondary-only word comes first.
claims.accuracy_evidence: Base adds no tests, but the existing test_ucd.py source isn't provided, so it's unclear whether such a test already exists.
claims.addressed_evidence: Neither X nor Y adds a UCD primary/secondary test.
